meta.title: 全身拍照姿势｜当旅游景点需要排队拍照时
meta.title_en: Full-Body Photo Poses | When the Scenic Spot Needs a Queued Photo
meta.topic: 拍照姿势 · 排队出片

scenes.context: 排队拍照第一招：腿一前一后，打破并腿站立。让身体有层次感。语域：拍照教学，排队场景。
sentences: Front stance: one leg forward, one back.
It breaks the stiff feet-together stand.
It gives the body more dimension.
paraphrase: 一前一后 → one forward, one back / staggered
scenes.speak: Front stance: one leg forward, one back. It breaks the stiff feet-together stand. It gives the body more dimension.

scenes.context: 侧身站姿：重心放一条腿，展示身体侧面线条。适合景点人多时快速出片。语域：拍照教学，侧身技巧。
sentences: Stand sideways, weight on one leg.
weight on one leg（重心在单腿）
You can still shoot fast in a crowd.
paraphrase: 重心 → weight / center of gravity
scenes.speak: Stand sideways, weight on one leg. Emphasize the side-body lines. You can still shoot fast in a crowd.

scenes.context: 半转身：身体微微扭转，手自然放置。扭转制造动态感。语域：拍照教学，动态姿态。
sentences: Half turn: the body twists slightly.
The twist adds a sense of motion.
paraphrase: 半转身 → half turn / a partial pivot
动态感 → a sense of motion / movement
scenes.speak: Half turn: the body twists slightly. Keep the hands placed naturally. The twist adds a sense of motion.

scenes.context: 走路抓拍：不需要摆姿势，走就对了。排队结束边走过边抓拍，最自然。语域：拍照教学，抓拍收尾。
sentences: 走路抓拍，不需要摆姿势。
Shooting while walking is the most natural.
paraphrase: 抓拍 → candid / snapping on the go
摆姿势 → posing / striking a pose
scenes.speak: Candid walking — no posing needed. Just keep walking. Shooting while walking is the most natural.

practice: Front stance: one leg forward, one back.
Stand sideways, weight on one leg.
Half turn: the body twists slightly.
pitfalls: 「腿一前一后」用 staggered 站位，别并腿。
Stand sideways, weight on one leg.
「重心放一条腿」用 weight on one leg。
「半转身」是 half turn，微微扭转即可。
「走路抓拍」用 candid walking，不用摆姿势。
shifts: 用 one leg forward, one back（一前一后）、weight on one leg（重心单腿）、half turn（半转身）
用 candid（抓拍）、in a crowd（人多时）、no posing needed（不用摆姿势）
用 shoot fast（快速出片）、keep walking（走就对了）、snapping on the go（边走边抓）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播转录，场景数据基于图文实录图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：腿一前一后、并腿站立、层次感、重心放一条腿、侧面线条、微微扭转、手自然放置、走路抓拍、不用摆姿势等。
